[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] DeceptionBench. DeceptionBench (Huang et al., 2025) tests whether models will assist users in carrying out deceptive actions toward a third party across a variety of domains, in both single-turn and multi-turn settings where an auxiliary agent applies sustained pressure. The primary metric is the deception score, the fraction of responses in which the model complies with the requested deceptive action (lower is better).

[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] Muse Spark 1.0 scores 1.9% in the multi-turn setting.
